sections.content: The imperfecto is used for: (1) habitual past actions — what you used to do; (2) background descriptions — what things were like; (3) past states and feelings. Here is the complete paradigm for reference.

items.es: De niño, vivía en Madrid, iba al colegio en metro y comía en casa.
items.en: As a child, I lived in Madrid, went to school by metro and ate at home.

items.es: Mi abuela era muy cariñosa. Siempre nos traía regalos.
items.en: My grandmother was very affectionate. She always brought us gifts.

sections.content: Whenever you want to talk about 'what life was like' or 'what you used to do', the imperfecto is almost certainly the right tense. Save the indefinido for specific completed events.
